# Feature: Play rules modal (Spielregeln)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Add a Play toolbar button „Spielregeln“ that opens a dismissible modal with the current V5 rules (from `SPIELANLEITUNG_V5_DRAFT.md`), per-section comment textareas persisted in localStorage, and a copy-all action that includes comments.

Roadmap: ad-hoc UX (Stufe B) — Playtest rule reference + annotation.

## Preconditions

- App open with Vite + React shell
- Solo match on the board (footer tools visible after deal)
- Toolbar shows Gegner / Log controls (`data-testid="game-toolbar-status"`)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Footer tools include „Spielregeln“ (`data-testid="play-rules-open"`) next to Log
- [ ] Click opens modal titled „Spielregeln“ (`data-testid="play-rules-modal"`), dismissible (Schließen / backdrop / Escape)
- [ ] Modal lists V5 rule sections (id + title + body) derived from `docs/rules/SPIELANLEITUNG_V5_DRAFT.md` `##` headings; content scrolls
- [ ] Each section has a comment textarea; typing persists under localStorage key `letz-fetz:play-rules-section-comments` keyed by section id
- [ ] „Regeln inkl. Kommentare kopieren“ copies title + body + optional „Kommentar:“ lines via `clipboard.writeText`; brief „Kopiert“ feedback shown

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty comments are omitted from copy output (no bare „Kommentar:“)
- [ ] localStorage unavailable / quota → comments still editable in-session without crash
- [ ] Clipboard failure → no crash; no false „Kopiert“ (or brief failure stays silent / no success label)
- [ ] Reopening modal restores previously saved comments for known section ids

## Regression

- [ ] Log button / MatchLogModal still works
- [ ] Gegner bot-mode select unchanged
- [ ] Phase coach footer phases/actions unchanged
- [ ] `npm run checks` green

## Assumptions

- Full V5 draft split on `##` is the content source (not a separate curated digest) — draft is already playtest-sized
- Section ids are stable slugs from heading text (e.g. `1-identitat-sieg`)
- No sonner Toaster wired in app — use inline „Kopiert“ label feedback
- Textarea primitive added under `components/ui/` (styleguide already documents it; was missing)
